intro: Whether you’re a researcher, musician, artist, instrument builder, or simply exploring new ways to make music, we’d love to see your contribution at the conference. There are many ways to get involved, grouped around two main deadlines.
themeNote: Engaging with the theme is welcome but optional. Work on any NIME topic is reviewed by the same criteria.
peerReviewedNote: Every submission receives double-blind peer review by at least three reviewers, and a meta-reviewer leads the discussion, writes a summary review and recommends a decision. Metadata are due one week earlier, on Sunday 24 January 2027.
juriedNote: Juried tracks are selected by a jury rather than through peer review. Jurors give brief assessments and the track chairs make the final decision, so authors may expect lighter feedback than a peer reviewed track provides.
elsewhere: The steps that are the same whichever track you choose are on [submission instructions](/call/submission-instructions). Every deadline is on [key dates](/call/key-dates).
reviewBody: Every peer reviewed submission gets three reviews from peer experts and a meta review from an experienced member of the community. That only works if enough people volunteer, so we ask everyone who submits to review as well. Reviewing runs through February 2027.
